'''Steamed golden carrots''' are the simple preparation of the [[golden carrot]], a secret [[ingredient]]. They heal {{Hp|2}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/golden_steamed_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} (through Regeneration IV instead of III) and gives Night Vision for 1:00. Cooking them grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
